name: How does GEO optimization differ from general SEO?
description: GEO optimization focuses on local search results using location-specific strategies, unlike general SEO's broader ranking goals.

mainEntity.name: How does GEO optimization differ from general SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: GEO optimization is a specialized subset of general SEO. While general SEO aims to improve overall search engine rankings for broad keywords, GEO optimization specifically focuses on local search results. It involves strategies like optimizing Google My Business profiles, acquiring local backlinks, and incorporating location-specific keywords. General SEO might target national or global audiences, whereas GEO optimization is precisely tailored to attract customers within a defined service area.
